        const starsContainer = document.getElementById('stars');
        const numberOfStars = 100;

        for (let i = 0; i < numberOfStars; i++) {
            const star = document.createElement('div');
            star.className = 'star';
            star.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
            star.style.top = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
            star.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 3 + 's';
            star.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 3 + 2) + 's';
            starsContainer.appendChild(star);
        }

        const numberOfParticles = 20;
        for (let i = 0; i < numberOfParticles; i++) {
            const particle = document.createElement('div');
            particle.className = 'particle';
            particle.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
            particle.style.top = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
            particle.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 8 + 's';
            particle.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 10 + 8) + 's';
            starsContainer.appendChild(particle);
        }

        const musicBtn = document.getElementById('musicBtn');
        const bgMusic = document.getElementById('bgMusic');
        const introVideo = document.getElementById('introVideo');
        let musicPlaying = false;
        
        introVideo.addEventListener('play', () => {
            if (!musicPlaying) {
                bgMusic.play().then(() => {
                    musicPlaying = true;
                    musicBtn.innerHTML = '<span>🔇</span> Tắt nhạc';
                }).catch(() => {});
            }
        });

        const events = ['click', 'touchstart', 'touchend'];
        events.forEach(event => {
            document.addEventListener(event, () => {
                if (!musicPlaying) {
                    bgMusic.play().then(() => {
                        musicPlaying = true;
                        musicBtn.innerHTML = '<span>🔇</span> Tắt nhạc';
                    }).catch(() => {});
                }
            }, { once: true, passive: true });
        });

        musicBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (musicPlaying) {
                bgMusic.pause();
                musicBtn.innerHTML = '<span>🔊</span> Bật nhạc';
                musicPlaying = false;
            } else {
                bgMusic.play().then(() => {
                    musicBtn.innerHTML = '<span>🔇</span> Tắt nhạc';
                    musicPlaying = true;
                }).catch(() => {});
            }
        });

        // Discord Stats - Update every 5 seconds
        async function updateDiscordStats() {
            try {
                // Extract server ID from invite link
                const inviteCode = '4ymUPpKH2E';
                const response = await fetch(`https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/${inviteCode}?with_counts=true`);
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.approximate_presence_count !== undefined) {
                    document.getElementById('discord-online').textContent = data.approximate_presence_count;
                    document.getElementById('discord-members').textContent = data.approximate_member_count || 'N/A';
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.log('Discord stats unavailable');
                document.getElementById('discord-online').textContent = '—';
                document.getElementById('discord-members').textContent = '—';
            }
        }

        // GitHub Stats
        async function updateGitHubStats() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/VTDROBLOX/Bytunghtml');
                const data = await response.json();
                document.getElementById('github-stats').innerHTML = `
                    <span class="stat-item">⭐ ${data.stargazers_count} Stars</span>
                    <span class="stat-item">🍴 ${data.forks_count} Forks</span>
                `;
            } catch (error) {
                document.getElementById('github-stats').innerHTML = '<span class="stat-item">⭐ —</span>';
            }
        }

        // YouTube Stats (note: requires API key for real data)
        async function updateYouTubeStats() {
            // YouTube API requires authentication, showing placeholder
            document.getElementById('youtube-stats').innerHTML = '<span class="stat-item">📊 Xem channel</span>';
        }

        // Facebook Stats (note: Facebook Graph API requires authentication)
        async function updateFacebookStats() {
            // Facebook API requires authentication, showing placeholder
            document.getElementById('facebook-stats').innerHTML = '<span class="stat-item">👥 Xem trang</span>';
        }

        // Initial load
        updateDiscordStats();
        updateGitHubStats();
        updateYouTubeStats();
        updateFacebookStats();

        // ── Visitor Counter (countapi.dev) ──
        // Tự tính +1 lượt xem mỗi lần page load tại GitHub Pages
        (async function () {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('https://api.countapi.dev/hit/tvu727531/visits');
                const data = await res.json();
                document.getElementById('visitor-count').textContent = data.value.toLocaleString();
            } catch (e) {
                document.getElementById('visitor-count').textContent = '—';
            }
        })();
    </script>
